$comment: Copy to features.json to choose what this install runs. Absent means 'use the defaults',
which is every feature on — an install that has never thought about it behaves exactly as
the app did before these switches existed.
features.json is gitignored on purpose: which parts you run is a property of your machine,
not of the project. Run `npm run features` to see what is on, off, and installed.
Switching a feature off unregisters its API routes, hides its tab in the app, and stops the
agent loading its code. Deleting the folders it owns removes it from disk entirely; the app
still boots and says 'not installed'. `npm run features` lists the folders for each.
